rule: Her fountain pens (Off duty › Pen shelf). Each pen: id, name, colour (body hex), trim (hex), nib ('fine'|'medium'|'broad'|''), ink (name or ''), inkHex, note, optional body (barrel hex when it differs from the cap), clip (false = no clip) and band (cap ring hex, defaults to trim). Drawn by penSVG() in index.html from her photo. Ink stays '' until she says. Optional facts: up to 3 short facts (about 70 characters each), checked against sources; shown when she taps the pen to flip it.

pens.name: Kaweco Perkeo
pens.note: Breezy Teal. Her first pen on the shelf (28 Nov 2026).
facts: The Perkeo name goes back to about 1900, when it was an eyedropper pen.
Kaweco began in 1883 as the Heidelberg fountain pen factory.
Its cap has 8 sides and its barrel has 16.

pens.name: Pilot Kakuno
pens.note: Soft yellow cap, white hexagonal barrel, no clip; smiley face on the nib (28 Nov 2026).
facts: The smiley face on the nib shows which way up to hold it.
White-barrel Kakunos have a winking face; it’s hexagonal so it won’t roll.
